info.title: Golemio API Universal API
info.description: Access real-time and open data from the Golemio Prague Data Platform, including city infrastructure, mobility, parking, waste, environmental, and public-service datasets.

get.description: Finds air quality station history in the Golemio API.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

get.description: Finds parking tariffs in the Golemio API.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

charge.description: Charge amount as provided by Golemio.

chargeType.description: Type of charge, such as ordinary, minimum, or maximum.

maxIterationsOfCharge.description: Maximum number of charge iterations, when provided.

minIterationsOfCharge.description: Minimum number of charge iterations, when provided.

dayInWeek.description: Day of week for the tariff period.

end.description: End time for the tariff period.

ph.description: Public-holiday applicability for the tariff period.

start.description: Start time for the tariff period.

periodsOfTime.description: Time periods when this charge applies.

validFrom.description: Start of validity for this charge rule.

validTo.description: End of validity for this charge rule, when provided.

freeOfCharge.description: Whether this band is free of charge.

lastModifiedAtSource.description: When the tariff category was last modified at the source.

maximumDuration.description: Maximum parking duration for this charge band, in seconds when provided.

paymentMethods.description: Available payment methods for the charge band.

paymentMode.description: Whether payment occurs before or after parking.

primarySource.description: Source system for the tariff charge band.

url.description: Provider URL for the charge band, when provided.

validTo.description: End of tariff validity, when provided.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
